svg.aria-label: Regnal-evaluation timeline of the divided monarchy. The northern Kingdom of Israel: all 19 kings judged evil. The southern Kingdom of Judah: 8 of 20 did right, the rest evil or unevaluated. Ordered by reign sequence; verdicts quoted from 1-2 Kings.
svg.title: Regnal Evaluations — the Deuteronomistic verdict
svg.text: Each king graded by one repeating formula: did he do right, or evil, in the sight of the LORD? (1–2 Kings)
KINGDOM OF JUDAH — 8 right · 11 evil · 1 none (of 20)
KINGDOM OF ISRAEL — 19 evil of 19: every northern king did evil
Ordered by reign sequence, not to scale — cells are uniform. Numbers in each cell give the order and reign length stated in the text (co-regencies overlap).

Absolute BCE dates omitted until a chronology (e.g. Thiele) is chosen. Elah & Shallum have no explicit evaluation formula but are placed with the dynasty they continue. Verdicts verified verbatim, 1–2 Kings.
